assessment: The NIFTY 50 research dataset (2,475 included observations) and walk-forward cross-validation splitting engine are structurally verified. However, core implementation gaps exist: multi-horizon targets (h=3, 5) are missing from app/prediction/target.py, PreviousCloseRegressor is missing from app/training/baselines.py, and no dedicated data loader enforces exclusion of the 14 unverified/special sessions. The instrument is retained at PARTIALLY_READY until these technical components are implemented.
reason: Promotion to READY_FOR_BASELINE_EVALUATION requires that dataset membership, session ordering, target construction, validation boundaries, and embargo be fully supported by implementation evidence. Key software components remain to be implemented.

dataset_membership_and_continuity.assessment: 2,475 contiguous included sessions verified with 100% dual-source price corroboration and zero duplicates

session_ordering_and_exclusions.assessment: 14 excluded dates identified; session continuity verified with max calendar gap of 5 days (holiday weekends)

target_construction_multi_horizon.assessment: Single-session (h=1) target is verified in app/prediction/target.py. Multi-horizon targets (h=3, 5) are missing from production target module and only exist in research scripts.

validation_boundaries_and_embargo.assessment: 5-fold expanding-window cross-validation and variable embargo are implemented and verified in app/training/walk_forward.py. Hardcoded default embargo=1 presents leakage risk for h>1.

reusable_baseline_estimators.assessment: MajorityClassClassifier is implemented. PreviousCloseRegressor and ZeroReturnRegressor are missing from app/training/baselines.py.

implementation_blockers_before_baseline_.description: Missing dedicated frozen dataset loader that automatically filters inclusion_status == 'INCLUDED' and verifies SHA-256 hashes.
Missing generic multi-horizon target generator for h=1, 3, 5 session horizons.
Missing reusable PreviousCloseRegressor and ZeroReturnRegressor classes with standard fit/predict methods.
Embargo parameter defaults to 1 without dynamically enforcing embargo >= horizon for multi-step targets.
